# --- Notes ---
# 1) Some packages such as `faiss-cpu` and `tensorflow` may require OS-specific wheels
#    or additional system prerequisites (CUDA for GPU builds). On Windows, prefer
#    `faiss-cpu` and the official TensorFlow Windows wheel matching your Python version.
# 2) If you want GPU acceleration for TensorFlow, replace `tensorflow==2.16.2`
#    with the appropriate `tensorflow` GPU package compatible with your CUDA/cuDNN.
# 3) `vosk` requires downloading its model files (the repo already contains a
#    `models/vosk-small-en-us-0.15/` directory used by the app).
# 4) If you plan to use transformer backends that require `torch`, add a
#    `torch` line matching your CUDA (e.g. `torch==2.2.2+cu118`), otherwise you can
#    install `torch` CPU wheel from PyPI or the official index.
